parsed.explanation: The write-up's Section 2 states exactly the ledger's large-prime-erasure content ("For every sequence term x, the set σ(x) is good") but its entire proof is "Induction over the sequence terms in increasing order (standard; details omitted)." No argument for all terms appears anywhere else: Section 4 of the falsification notes only mentions that "The construction Rp^k repairs this boundary issue" without defining R, k, or proving minimality/membership, and the computational section explicitly disclaims proof status. Hence the forward direction of (3), and with it the invariance (4) quoted, rests on an unproved lemma. Repair requires supplying the omitted induction, i.e. a lemma-level edit.
